name: Semerarete ~Osananajimi~
source:
Main character gets disgusted with lover Airi constant lust and runs away to the city. But after some time he accidentally meets Airi again, and old feelings make young people reunite. Will he be able to contain Airi's libido this time?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-june-2006-h2o-footprints-in.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
男主角厌倦恋人芝崎爱理永无止境的欲望，逃到了城市。但过了一段时间，他意外与爱理重逢，旧日感情让两名年轻人重新走到一起。这次，他能控制住爱理的性欲吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-june-2006-h2o-footprints-in.html]vndbreview[/url]]
